name: Personal File Space
description: A single user's local files (papers, slides, documents, code, data, images, meeting notes, mail exports) and the work history they record.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: A person named in the files (author, recipient, colleague, contact)

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: A company, institution, team, or group the owner works with

entity_types.name: Project
entity_types.description: A work unit the owner pursues (research topic, client job, course, long-term task)

entity_types.name: Document
entity_types.description: A work artifact discussed inside the text (a report, deck, paper, contract)

entity_types.name: Event
entity_types.description: A concrete happening with a date (meeting, deadline, submission, review, trip)

entity_types.name: Topic
entity_types.description: A named subject or theme explicitly stated in the text (for facets and filters)

entity_types.name: Artifact
entity_types.description: A concrete deliverable or tool (dataset, prototype, slide deck, codebase)

entity_types.name: Technology
entity_types.description: A method, framework, model, or tool named as a technique

entity_types.name: TimePeriod
entity_types.description: A named span of time (Q3 2025, last spring, the 2026 hiring season)

entity_types.name: Metric
entity_types.description: A measured value with meaning (accuracy, budget, revenue, score)

entity_types.name: Decision
entity_types.description: A choice that was made, with its rationale or outcome

relation_types.name: AUTHORED_BY
relation_types.description: A document or artifact was written by a person or organization

relation_types.name: MENTIONS
relation_types.description: A document or artifact refers to another entity

relation_types.name: PART_OF
relation_types.description: An entity belongs to a project or event (person to project, artifact to project)

relation_types.name: PRODUCES
relation_types.description: A person, project, or event yields an artifact, document, or metric

relation_types.name: USES
relation_types.description: A person, project, or artifact relies on a technology, artifact, or place

relation_types.name: PRECEDES
relation_types.description: One event or time period happens before another

relation_types.name: SUPERSEDES
relation_types.description: One document replaces another in content (cross-file, judged by text)

relation_types.name: RELATES_TO
relation_types.description: Two entities are related and no sharper relation applies

relation_types.name: LOCATED_IN
relation_types.description: An entity is sited or happens in a place

relation_types.name: HAS_METRIC
relation_types.description: An entity carries a measured value

relation_types.name: DECIDED_IN
relation_types.description: A decision was made in an event or time period

query_classes.name: locating
query_classes.hyde_instruction: Write as a file index entry would: name the file or document, the project it belongs to, where it lives, and what it contains.

query_classes.name: project
query_classes.hyde_instruction: Write as a project dossier would: name the project, its members, its deliverables, and the period it was active.

query_classes.name: person
query_classes.hyde_instruction: Write as a contact summary would: name the person, their organization, their role, and which documents or events involve them.

query_classes.name: timeline
query_classes.hyde_instruction: Write as a work journal would: give dates, events in order, and what was produced in each period.
